config.notes: R214 deployment (run_state_policy.py). Gains, scale and payload match training / the R187 sysid setup. Limits are our safety stops, not training settings: wrist box = R214 sim rollout wrist range + margin; min wrist height 0.11 m above the table (training minimum 0.133 m); Speed stops: R214 moves up to ~1 m/s in sim (R220 p99 per-step motion 64-102 mm); lower them for cautious first runs. Cube ages: the bottom cube is static and often hidden by the arm while stacking (10 s); a free carried cube must be re-detected within 2 s (hidden by the fingers while grasping); a held cube (gripper reports stopping on it while closing) is carried with the wrist from its last sighting (latency_compensation) with no age limit, since the overhead L515 rarely sees its tags; if the grip is lost it is a free cube again (2 s). Start pose: a Reaching-family training start (R214 start bank row 7738, family ObjectAnywhereEEAnywhere), (15.6, -145.8, -70.3, -144.6, -160.0, 96.0) deg: S-W-E-, gripper 4 deg from straight down, wrist 0.47 m above the table, wrist 3 at 96 deg; chosen so the arm is >= 0.12 m from every L515 line of sight to the trained cube region (the previous start, R217 row 5692, hid a third of it). The runner requires every joint within start_joint_tolerance_rad of it; move_to_start.py takes the arm there.
